candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to the order service fails with transport errors at ~2s, indicating downstream order-service latency/timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: Gateway-side evidence only; order service logs/metrics not observed to confirm whether latency originates in order, inventory, payment, or postgresql.

report.explanation: All 12 checkout requests return 502 at ~2s; paired client requests to order fail with transport errors at ~2s while /readyz stays 200. Consistent with downstream latency at the order dependency, but order-side evidence is absent to localize the root cause.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/metrics for POST /v1/orders latency and errors
Order service dependency latency (inventory, payment, postgresql) to localize the ~2s stall
Confirmation of client timeout configuration causing 502 vs upstream error
